title: data/precursors/*.json source files

_meta.description: Free-form metadata (source URLs, scrapedAt timestamp, etc.)

winners.description: Optional. For ceremonies with tied/co-winners in a single category (DD 67th+ gender-neutral performance categories, occasional design ties), list ALL winning shows. Enrich credits each show with a win. `winner` is the legacy single-string equivalent. If both are present, `winners` takes precedence. Tied winners must still appear in `nominees`.

oneOf.title: Pulitzer shape — array of {year, winner, finalists[]} (title-keyed)
Pulitzer historic shape — array of {year, winnerId?, finalistIds?[]} (showId-keyed; at least one of winnerId/finalistIds required)
